fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that Rs. 7,500 was debited from the account of the complainant through UPI after a collect request from an unknown UPI ID was approved. The matter was brought to Chennai North PS on 2025-01-10, while the incident was placed on 2025-01-10 at roughly 19:20. The complainant, Meena Ammal, provided the contact number 9000000431. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100070 as the destination of the transfer. Ramya Bai (9000000232) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant alleged that Thirumal Palanisamy may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000135. The complainant mentioned a bank transaction reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim was allegedly induced to approve a collect request on a UPI app.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, suspect, evening, main street, mobile number, receiving account, bank reference
